issuer.name: 中國鋼鐵
issuer.priorRouteEvidence: Iron ore/coke/flux -> blast furnace hot metal; hot metal plus scrap -> converter steelmaking.

sourceEvent.title: 中鋼一一五年十月盤及第四季季盤盤價
sourceEvent.publicationDateEvidence: 2026-09-04 corroborated by contemporaneous republication; current official HTML fetch does not expose a machine-readable publication timestamp, so historical firstKnownAt is not self-authenticated by this receipt.

rawMaterialContext: metallurgical coal recently rose USD 50-65/t to about USD 275/t
issuer explicitly states this raised steelmaking costs
sourceFacts.pricingDecisionRule: Issuer states it considers steelmaking costs, international market conditions, downstream business conditions and product-specific demand.

interpretation.procurementCostBasis: PARTIAL / benchmark context not realized inventory cost

positiveMechanism: Issuer-level pricing announcements can prospectively reveal whether management explicitly recognizes input-cost pressure and responds through posted product prices.
Product-level price matrices provide a direct Taiwan PIT object for pricing-power/pass-through research rather than inferring pricing power from commodity prices alone.
counterevidence: Some products were raised while others were unchanged under the same cost backdrop; therefore pass-through is not uniform even within one issuer.
The issuer simultaneously cites international prices, downstream conditions and product demand, so raw-material cost is not an isolated causal driver.
Posted price changes do not prove realized transaction ASP, shipment mix, contract discounts, inventory accounting or gross-margin protection.
A later margin improvement could come from demand/mix/volume/FX/inventory/energy rather than pricing power; a later margin decline does not prove failed pass-through without those controls.
requiredFutureFields: input benchmark observation and source vintage
promotionReason: A Taiwan issuer's official product-pricing announcement directly exposes input-cost narrative, decision criteria and product-specific price adjustments. This validates a replayable prospective pricing-power/pass-through data object. It does not establish predictive efficacy, realized margin preservation or a permanent sign.
